name: T-Eval
intro: T-Eval把工具使用分解为规划、推理、检索、理解、调用和复审六种能力。其553条经两轮人工核验的黄金工具轨迹由15个工具的完整文档、GPT生成查询、多智能体轨迹和人工筛选构成，并拆解为23,305个分步测试用例。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Jilin Un

metric: 规划、推理、检索、理解、调用、复审六项分数及总体平均分
eval_feature: 过程级评测, 黄金工具轨迹, 六能力分解
scale: 553条黄金工具轨迹、23,305个分步测试用例
build_method_en: Tool-document construction, GPT-3.5 query generation, GPT-4 refinement, multi-agent trajectory generation, and two-round human verification
eval_feature_en: Process-level evaluation, golden tool trajectories, six-ability decomposition
intro_en: T-Eval decomposes tool use into planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, and review. Its 553 golden tool trajectories are built from full documentation for 15 tools, GPT-generated queries, multi-agent trajectories, and two rounds of human verification, then decomposed into 23,305 step-level test cases.
scale_en: 553 golden tool trajectories and 23,305 step-level test cases
metric_en: Planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, review, and overall mean

drawio_review_note: Aligned with T-Eval arXiv:2312.14033 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official open-compass/T-Eval repository. T-Eval decomposes tool utilization into planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, and review. The benchmark defines 15 tools across Research, Travel, Entertainment, Web, Life, and Financial domains and supplies complete human-written tool documentation. Tools are uniformly sampled, GPT-3.5 generates user queries from shuffled documentation and few-shot examples, and GPT-4 refines them. A planner, executor, and reviewer multi-agent annotator produces golden thought-action-observation-review trajectories. Humans review and filter 1,500 initial instruction-solution pairs twice, retaining 553 golden trajectories that are decomposed into 23,305 step-level test cases. Planning compares predicted and golden action sequences with Sentence-BERT similarity, Hopcroft-Karp matching, and ordered-sequence matching. Reasoning compares the next thought, retrieval checks the next tool, understanding compares parameters, invocation checks tool name and arguments, and review is a five-way multiple-choice diagnosis. The six subset scores are averaged for overall process performance; end-to-end win rate is also reported in the paper.
